title: 문과 건물 안 표지판 읽기: 미세요? 당기세요?
summary: Ten short signs you see on doors and inside Korean buildings: push, pull, entrance, exit, emergency exit, restroom, in use, out of order, no entry and no smoking. For each one, you learn what it means and what to do.
objective: Read 10 common door and building signs (미세요, 당기세요, 입구, 출구, 비상구, 화장실, 사용 중, 고장, 출입 금지, 금연) and choose or say the right action for each one.

sections.heading: On the door: push or pull?
paragraphs: Both signs are polite requests to you, the person at the door. To say what you do, use 밀어요 (I push) and 당겨요 (I pull).

items.text: Push. It comes from 밀다 (to push). The ㄹ drops before -세요, so you see 미세요, not 밀세요.
Pull. It comes from 당기다 (to pull).

example.en: This door is heavy. I push it hard.

items.text: entrance, the way in. 입 means 'enter'.
exit, the way out. 출 means 'go out'.
emergency exit. Use it in a fire or another emergency.
restroom. This sign only tells you where the restroom is.
in use or occupied. Someone is using it now, so wait.
out of order or broken. Do not use it. People also say 고장 났어요 (It broke down).

example.en: The elevator is out of order. Let's take the stairs.

sections.heading: Signs that say 'don't'

items.text: no entry. 출입 means 'going in and out', and 금지 means 'forbidden'. Do not go through this door.
no smoking. 금 means 'forbid', and 연 means 'smoke'.

example.en: This is a no-smoking area. Please smoke outside.

sections.note: Tip: 입구, 출구 and 출입 all use 입 (in) and 출 (out). If you learn these two parts, you can often guess new signs.

task.title: Read the signs and act
task.line: Use the sign meanings in this worksheet to match, choose or fill in the right answer for each item.

exercises.ask: Write the sign from the box that matches each meaning (미세요, 당기세요, 입구, 출구, 비상구):
items: way in / pull / emergency exit / push / way out

exercises.ask: Write the sign from the box that matches each meaning (화장실, 사용 중, 고장, 출입 금지, 금연):
items: no smoking / out of order / restroom / no entry / in use

exercises: Does the sign say something is broken or in use? Write Broken, In use or Neither for each sign: 고장 / 사용 중 / 화장실 / 비상구

exercises.ask: Is it OK to do this? Write Yes or No:
items: You smoke under a 금연 sign. / You walk through a door marked 출입 금지. / You leave the building through the door marked 출구. / During a fire, you run to the door marked 비상구.
